text.formatted: The boar has Advantage on melee attack rolls while it is Bloodied.
text.plain: The boar has Advantage on melee attack rolls while it is Bloodied.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.
